Method of Attack: Uses virtualization to run malicious code in a container to evade detection
Installs the APK of the targeted banking app and executes malicious code within the same container
Hooks key APIs to capture credentials, manipulate transactions, intercept sensitive information
Manipulates user interface elements to close warning dialogs
Hooks APIs related to GooglePlayServices to hamper root-related security checks
Performs on-device fraud and social engineering (e.g., calls pretending to be bank customer service)
Impacted Systems: Android devices, Banking apps in Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia
Attack Vector: Malicious APKs disguised as legitimate banking apps
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious APKs running banking apps inside virtual containers
Virtual container environment breaking Android Sandbox
